description: Can I scrape this site, and how? Returns a verdict (open, guarded, hostile, blocked), a hostility score, a recommended approach with steps and risks, bot protections, robots.txt and AI-crawler policy, machine-readable surfaces (sitemap, llms.txt, JSON-LD), and eu_ai_training: the signals the EDPB draft Guidelines 03/2026 on web scraping for generative AI count against collecting personal data (robots.txt blocks on AI training crawlers, a Content-Signal of ai-train=no, ai.txt, CAPTCHAs, login walls), as none, some or strong. Signals, not legal advice. Uses a weekly-probed dataset of several hundred sites; for any other domain it probes live from a datacenter IP.
name: check_site
